from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CreditImpairmentRecord(BaseModel):
    """One company's reported credit impairment loss for its financial report period."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company the document belongs to")
    credit_impairment_loss: float | None = Field(description="The credit impairment loss amount reported")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="The currency/unit of the amount, e.g., '元'")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., '2024年第一季度'")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt anchoring the extracted value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    credit_impairment_records: list[CreditImpairmentRecord]
